howToRead.tileMetres: real width of one texture tile in metres: texture.repeat.set(surfaceWidth / tileMetres, surfaceHeight / tileMetres)
howToRead.tileSize: source = measured by the source site, estimate = our best guess, exact = drawn to that size here, whole surface = one copy covers the whole object (no repeat)
howToRead.maps: Color is sRGB; Normal is OpenGL style (green up), right for three.js and Blender; Roughness, AO, Metalness and Opacity are linear grey maps
howToRead.medianColour: median sRGB colour of the Color map (opaque pixels only for overlays and decals)
